description: Presidential Secretariat - The Public Security Ordinance, Call cut with effect from 22.07.2023 all the Members of the Armed Force for the maintenance of the Public Order
reasoning: This gazette content is an order issued by the President under the Public Security Ordinance, calling out the armed forces for the maintenance of public order. It constitutes a legal/regulatory action as it exercises powers granted by existing legislation (Chapter 40) and creates a legally binding directive. The content focuses on the implementation of legal authority rather than government personnel changes, structural reorganization, or any of the other specialized categories.
